relations.subject: Bogdan Petriceicu Haşdeu
relations.evidence: son of the luminary Alexandru Hâjdeu (1811–1872). His father had read Bopp’s comparative grammar and encouraged his son to linguistic studies.

relations.subject: Bogdan Petriceicu Haşdeu
relations.evidence: From 1900 Professor at Bucharest University, mainly taught philosophy.

relations.evidence: Among his students was L. Saineanu.
